columns.user_id: BIGINT positive immutable original UID; no FK
columns.record_revision: BIGINT positive default1; increment exactly once per mutation; CAS for cleanup
columns.render_revision: BIGINT positive default1; immutable stable single attempt; not record CAS
columns.render_state: VARCHAR(24) IN_FLIGHT | CONFIRMED_EDIT | NO_EDIT | UNCERTAIN; default IN_FLIGHT
columns.cleanup_state: VARCHAR(16) NOT_REQUIRED | PENDING | CLEANED; default NOT_REQUIRED
columns.invalidated_by_credentials_version: nullable BIGINT >= original credentials_version; first invalidation fence preserved
columns.created_at: TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(); immutable
columns.render_completed_at: nullable TIMESTAMPTZ; present once state != IN_FLIGHT
columns.invalidated_at: nullable TIMESTAMPTZ; present iff invalidated generation present
columns.cleanup_outcome: nullable VARCHAR(16) DELETED | ABSENT | SANITIZED; present iff CLEANED

render_receipt: Exact immutable tuple + positive render_revision; input record_revision may predate invalidation. IN_FLIGHT -> declared typed outcome once; idempotent same receipt. Never grant new attempt from replay, invalidation or terminal render. Fresh user-first authority/binding/generation recheck; lost/deleted authority invalidates and returns CLEANUP_REQUIRED unless already terminal cleaned.
cleanup_receipt: Exact original tuple, current positive record_revision CAS, matching positive invalidation fence and canonical event_id; stale CAS FAILED_PRECONDITION. DELETED/ABSENT allowed while IN_FLIGHT/UNCERTAIN. SANITIZED only CONFIRMED_EDIT/NO_EDIT. Unknown/failure/uncertain cleanup never terminal.
list: Original user_id; invalidated_by_credentials_version IS NOT NULL AND <= supplied event fence AND cleanup_state=PENDING, including IN_FLIGHT/UNCERTAIN. Stable record_id cursor1..200 pages. Account missing/archived/unlinked does not deny exact persisted-card cleanup.
own_read: mode field6, explicit SNAPSHOT1 requires both expected versions0; RECHECK2 both positive; absent/unknown/mixed invalid. found fresh exactUID/binding/unarchived validACTIVEown durable grant; defaultrole not gate. eligible separately unchanged and initial nonempty. Both login+initial blank whenever !eligible. Valid ADMIN FULL/LIMITED own grants eligible; HEADMAN/helper base grant consistency must be preserved.
